problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package 1: size 68 units
* Package 2: size 52 units
* Package 3: size 66 units
* Package 4: size 58 units
* Package 5: size 51 units
* Package 6: size 54 units
* Package 7: size 62 units
* Package 8: size 53 units
* Package 9: size 70 units
* Package 10: size 37 units
* Package 11: size 38 units
* Package 12: size 50 units
* Package 13: size 31 units
* Package 14: size 41 units
* Package 15: size 38 units
* Package 16: size 31 units
* Package 17: size 51 units
* Package 18: size 68 units
* Package 19: size 42 units
* Package 20: size 32 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
